jobs.description: Meet the Team The DSE Platform Independent Common (PI-Common) group develops high-performance, platform-independent system software that runs across Cisco s flagship routers and switches. These components form the foundation of networking deployments across enterprise, service provider, cloud, and AI infrastructure environments, where scale, resiliency, security, programmability, and operational debuggability are critical. Your impact As a Software Engineer in PI-Common, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of routing protocol and routing infrastructure software used across Cisco platforms. You will work with senior engineers to build reliable, scalable, and debuggable control-plane software. Key responsibilities include: Developing features, enhancements, and defect fixes for IGP protocols, BGP-LS, FHRP technologies, and routing infrastructure components. Writing clean, efficient, maintainable code in C/C++ for multi-threaded, system-level software environments. Contributing to routing infrastructure components such as route-policy handling, filtering, prefix processing, and control-plane integration modules. Debugging software issues using logs, traces, core files, protocol state, and platform-level diagnostics. Participating in root cause analysis for defects and customer-found issues, with guidance from senior engineers. Building unit, functional, regression, and scale validation coverage for protocol and infrastructure changes. Working closely with platform, hardware, and test teams to validate software behavior across Cisco operating systems and platforms. Learning protocol behavior, implementation details, and operational aspects of production routing systems. Participating in design discussions, code reviews, and technical reviews to build strong engineering judgment. Contributing to team quality, automation, debuggability, and continuous improvement initiatives. Minimum qualifications required Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related technical field. 0-3 years of relevant software development experience. Strong understanding of data structures, operating systems, and computer networking fundamentals. Programming experience in C or C++. Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Perl. Familiarity with Unix/Linux development environments. Good problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. Preferred qualifications (good to have) Exposure to routing protocols such as OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP, RIP, BGP, or BGP-LS. Familiarity with debugging tools such as gdb, logs, packet captures, traces, or core-file analysis. Exposure to networking software, embedded systems, distributed systems, or large-scale infrastructure software. Ability to learn complex technical areas quickly and work well in a team environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - .Net / React.js
jobs.description: Job Description : We are looking for a talented Full Stack Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge web applications. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining both frontend and backend components of our software solutions. Your expertise in React, JavaScript, Bootstrap, .NET, and Python will be crucial in driving the success of our projects and delivering exceptional user experiences. Key Responsibilities : - Design and develop responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces using React.js, JavaScript, and Bootstrap, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance across various devices and browsers. - Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate design mockups and wireframes into fully functional frontend components, incorporating best practices for user interface design and accessibility. - Implement backend functionalities and APIs using .NET and Python, leveraging frameworks such as ASP.NET and Django to build robust and scalable server-side solutions. - Integrate frontend and backend components to create cohesive web applications, utilizing RESTful APIs and asynchronous communication patterns to enable data exchange and interaction between client and server. - Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, following coding standards and best practices to ensure code quality, readability, and reusability. - Conduct thorough testing of frontend and backend functionalities, including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests, to identify and resolve issues and ensure the reliability and stability of the software. - Optimize application performance and scalability through code refactoring, performance tuning, and caching strategies, addressing bottlenecks and improving overall system efficiency. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and quality assurance testers, to define requirements, plan project milestones, and deliver high-quality software solutions on time and within budget. - Stay updated with the latest technologies, trends, and best practices in web development, and proactively recommend and implement innovative solutions to enhance the functionality, usability, and performance of our applications. - Provide technical guidance and support to junior developers, sharing knowledge and mentoring team members to foster professional growth and development. Qualifications :- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.- Proven experience (X years) working as a Full Stack Developer, with expertise in frontend and backend development using React, JavaScript, Bootstrap, .NET, and Python. - Proficiency in building responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces using React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with a strong understanding of modern web development principles and best practices.- Hands-on experience with frontend frameworks and libraries such as Bootstrap, Material-UI, or Semantic UI, and proficiency in designing and implementing UI components and layouts. - Solid understanding of backend development concepts and experience with server-side technologies such as .NET (C#, ASP.NET) and Python (Django, Flask), including RESTful API development and database integration. - Familiarity with software development tools and methodologies, including version control systems (e.g., Git), issue tracking systems (e.g., Jira), and Agile/Scrum practices.- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to analyze complex requirements, troubleshoot issues, and propose effective solutions. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment and interact with stakeholders at all levels.-- Continuous learner with a passion for exploring new technologies and enhancing technical skills. - Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus. Location- Delhi NCR, Bengaluru,Chennai,Pune,Kolkata,Ahmedabad,Mumbai,Hyderabad 2-4 Yrs nan

jobs.title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description BETSOLs team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources. We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT. Key responsibilities Testing SAM publisher implementations Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output. Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover. Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not. Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts. Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line). Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances. Building and running test automation Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines. Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight. Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks. Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers. Quality process and reporting Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current. Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT. Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment. Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. Qualifications Required qualifications Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience. Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance. Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries. Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from. Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr. Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth. Preferred qualifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus. Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based). Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports.
